title: Behind this gate: an emperor's private lake — Summer Palace | Beijing, Walked EP2 | China Travel Expert
description:
A painted corridor... and then the lake opens up.

Real footage from the Summer Palace, Beijing: the gate, the painted beams of the Long Corridor, and Kunming Lake beyond. This is where emperors escaped the summer.

🧭 Expert Tip: walk the corridor first, then take the boat across the lake.
